reviews.title: Happy for over 7 yrs…Until now
reviews.content: I've been with Verizon for over 7 yrs without a single issue…until the last couple of months.  Recently I've had issues with very slow phone connections.  Additionally, I wanted to upgrade the phone I bought from Verizon.  As far as the connection problems, after suffering through a confusing phone tree system I finally was able to connect with a service rep.  His only suggestion was resetting phone network options, which did nothing, service is still having problems.  Regarding attempts to purchase a new phone, their web site keeps logging out of my account when I hit various links including those for new phone devices and the BYOP page.  [FYI - I’m a former director of web design and development for another company.] Called customer service severals times beginning in early June and each time they've acknowledged the ongoing web site problem.  As of this writing (August 27th) it's still not fixed!  Decided instead to try calling sales department directly to see if they could assist with getting a new device and two times my calls were disconnected.  Reps stated they would call back if call was dropped and they never did.  Then tried three times to speak to someone via their Live Chat on computer:  Once they took 5-8 mins between each response and after 30 mins of not even being able to ever get to the point of asking my question I gave up.  Another time chat box disconnected the conversation. And the last time, the chat box broke down completely while texting with rep with an automated response popping up saying it "doesn't know the answer to my question." (??)  I don't know what's happened to Verizon internally, but it went from a company I previously was very satisfied with to a horrible mess that is falling apart on all fronts involving their customer technical and web support as well as sales operations.  They’ve lost a once loyal customer.

reviews.title: So I changed banks and stopped my auto…
reviews.content: So I changed banks and stopped my auto pay for two billing cycles.When I opened the new bank accounts I set up Autopay in the Verizon app but did not get a confirmation email but since I didn't have an issue setting up the new Autopay I didn't think anything of it.When my first bill arrived after I “set up Autopay” I watched the Verizon video that comes with my bill and at the end of the video it states  "You are enrolled in Autopay and your bill will be paid on 4/27” so I figured there was no issue with my set up.But when the due date came the bill wasn't paid and FOUR DAYS PAST THE DUE DATE I was notified via email that I missed my payment and a late fee of $25 would be added to my next bill. I used my credit card to pay the missed payment and once again enrolled in Autopay.When I checked my “next bill preview” a week later the preview did not show the late fee of $25 so I figured it was an error and was corrected.Then that next bill arrived with the $25 late fee but the video attached stated once again "you are enrolled in autopay and your bill will be paid on 5/27.Investigation in store with a Verizon rep showed that the app did give me a message that read "could not complete transaction" BUT IT APPEARS AS A SMALL BANNER AT THE TOP OF THE PAGE IN A NARROW BAR AND THEN DISAPPEARS! So when I set it up Autopay that error message did show up BUT it disappeared before I could see it.So yes I missed that VANISHING MESSAGE but I have to ask why would something so important be shown in a small bar that disappears in seconds?!Why NO email alert for something so important as a failed Autopay set up?!Three comments on this process and the $25 late fee:1. Verizon DO BETTER THAN A VANISHING MESSAGE IN A TINY BAR AT THE TOP OF THE PAGE WHEN AUTOPAY SETUP FAILS!! Funny how you do so little about that yet can send me 20 email offers for new phones EVERY WEEK!2. Verizon MAKE SURE YOUR BILL EXPLANATION VIDEO COMMENTARY MATCHES THE CURRENT PAYMENT METHOD AND DON'T SAY "AUTOPAY IS SET UP" WHEN IT IS NOT!!3. Don't bill me for a late fee when you are completely incapable of telling me that the Autopay YOUR VIDEO TOLD ME WAS SET UP wasn't and don’t take 4 days to tell me the bill is past due and I am unable to correct the payment method before it goes past due!!

All she had left was the landline and it wasn’t much better.Anyway, some sort of debit card with the refund was finally sent to us. Can"t wait to see if it actually works.

reviews.title: DECEITFUL, Bait & Switch, USELESS customer service
reviews.content: DECEITFUL, BAIT AND SWITCH with THE WORST customer service.  Every person says something different.  You go with what someone tells you in the store, you get your bill, it is wrong you try to call the store but get the automated line, takes min 30 mins to get through, they either tell you one thing then it's not done, tell you to go to the store, the store tells you to call, each person tells you something contradictory to the last one, they say it's straightened out.  My most recent call (I have now been to the store 4 times and 3 calls) they told me, no the correction you are saying the woman said was done was not done, is not possible to be done, go to the store, make them fix it, don't leave the store until they show you it is fixed on your bill.  I don't even know where to start...we went with the Dec BOGO deal, they sent me home with a phone to activate, I was 12 hours without service, then the bill showed the phone was not free, that I owed over $700 for it, the $300 payment in store did not show up and was being charged for that.  Went back to the store after not being able to get through on the phone, they said, oh you already got a phone free you want two free phones and said it was free like they'd said.  The bill continues to not reflect that it is free, after a 45 min wait on another call in, she looks it up, says it does indeed qualify for the BOGO but I need to wait 1 to 2 billing cycles.  Now the second billing cycle comes, still shows I owe payments on the phone.  After a 30 min wait time to get on the phone, he says it is not listed as BOGO could never have been eligible for BOGO, the things the woman said was done on the last call is not in there or in the notes, and to go to the store and make them apply the BOGO, and to not leave the store until it shows up on my Verizon login.  MEANWHILE, I have not been able to login to Verizon. I simply get the msg "I need help that does not require signing in bc my issue is with signing in, NONE of the links work, I keep getting "Sorry we are not able to process your request at this time."  He says to unregister then reregister, but that also gives me the same unable to process your request.  When you ask for password reset you get that msg.  When you try and ask for help in the chat, you get the msg that you have to be logged in for help...even though the issue is with the login.  I live in Hawaii, and customer service hours are mainland hours, so with long wait times and their hours, odds are low to get through.  Also, the woman said the bill for both would be $150, last month is was over $300, this month is is over $200, they said you save $10 for autopay and paperless, but it keeps getting added back on, you set it up and it cancels it.  ALSO, I am supposed to get free Hulu and Discovery but due to ongoing login issues can't get in to set that up with the second account (since we got two lines just bc of this BOGO deal), and it will probably expire before I can ever even get logged in.  This has been a nightmare.  DON'T USE VERIZON.  Go elsewhere.  I regret it...and sadly even attempting to fix it or get out of it continues to be unsolvable.  ANY company at this point would be better than this.  Deeply disappointed. I am so tired of telling my story over and over, having to re-explain, then explain what the last people have told us.  It is exhausting and so far getting nowhere.  AND costing way more.  Don't believe their advertised prices.

reviews.title: The latest upgrade offer by verizon has…
reviews.content: The latest upgrade offer by verizon has been the worst experience I have ever had to endure with any company EVER! From misleading information from their reps, to outright lies from their reps. I don't care if they gave me a top of the line iPhone (which is what I upgraded to based on a $800 trade-in value for my old phone) for free, this experience (which has still not been completed) would still not be worth it. It has cost me hours of my life I will never get back due to the endless phone calls trying to resolve the problems that started immediately. I realize most people will not find this, nor will factor it in, but will have to learn the hard way because we all just want what we want and want to believe. Both my wife and I continue to have to call every month when our new bill from verizon shows up, and have to continue to fight to get them to put things the way things were promised. We have both had to learn the hard way just how poor verizon is. And this whole "you are not in a contract" selling point. There is more than one way to get you into a "contract". If you don't agree to an interest-free payment plan on your new phone (24 months at a minimum), then you don't get the offer of a high trade-in value of your old phone. One of the things the verizon reps will misrepresent with. Which simply means that you have to stay with verizon for another two years until your phone is paid off, even though you are not legally bound into a contract. But if you tap out early, then you are charged full price for your new phone and your trade-in value disappears. But good luck public: get that new latest and greatest iPhone 'cause it is sooo cool (extreme sarcasm)! You will be the latest envy of your friends with your new iPhone. Just don't do it with verizon. I have talked to 7 different verizon reps and this list I am sure, will continue to grow: Mary (Philippino-outsourced call center from what I can tell), Judy (another Phillipino call center moment) Zanetta, Victoria, Ron, Marcy, and last but not least, Joe. All this within the month of January of 2022. Since this review says it will send a copy to verizon, I will even include my order number for the world to see: 10313526, Location Code: P218101, Order Date: 12/28/2021 iPhone 13 Pro Max. Overall, one of the worst decisions I have made... but hey.. I am sure it happening to BOTH my wife and I (we have completely separate verizon accounts also) represent the exception rather than the rule.

reviews.title: Worst customer service I’ve ever experienced
reviews.content: I switched to T-mobile in September 2020 because it was less expensive and I could never get through to a Verizon rep without waiting for 20-30 minutes.  I believed that my Verizon account was cancelled at that time as my number was switched over.  However, Verizon continued to bill $80/month for my account.  In October 2020, after waiting on hold & being transferred to numerous agents to address the issue and having to repeat the problem each time, an agent told me I’d paid the final bill and my account was closed.  Given that the main phone number was transferred & “closed,” I was unable to access any information on Verizon.com about my account.  After several months of still continuing to receive bills into 2021, writing letters, calling, and being put on hold for up to 90 minutes at a time, I was finally able to ascertain that the bills related to an old Jetpack with a different phone number attached—a number I didn’t know & couldn’t locate given that I hadn’t used the jet pack in a year.  I spent over 15 hours between letters, phone calls, contacting the store which sold me the jet pack back in 2017, and still kept receiving bills for a closed account.  Ultimately Verizon sent my account to collections, which was a shock as I have perfect credit and had never had an account in collections before.  I finally gave up and paid for a service that was cancelled many months prior.

HELLO it can be both!!! call in and will be on hold for some 45 estimated minutes and they instruct you to go through your phone via link via text message.  tried to sign up through the app. as the website wasn't taking our written down password,  then would say user id not recognized, so go to sign up again, and says user name is already signed up. Hello??? It is going to be see ya Verizon.  Enough is enough. And I feel I didn't get a new phone from them as it was set to a foreign language!  We are in the U.S. My husbands android did something that locked him out, and he stopped at two verizon stores, and they said sorry nothing we can do.  go to Walmart. so he went to Walmart and it was a so simple fix to open it up.   On the website, started chat,  and was told 20 minute wait, so waited, and poof, after about 15 minutes, bounced me off and said chat and log in was cancelled due to inactivity??????    Want lots of aggravation.  go to Verizon. We have now signed up with t Mobile, they paid off my iPhone, we have better coverage, 4/5 bars on our phones and my iPad, and we are paying almost $80.00 less each month for the same coverage!! And we checked out two near by locations and each had 4 people working.  Stop at Verizon, and you will probably find only one employee, two at the most.  Your wait time at t mobile, will be very brief, if at all.  at Verizon, you can expect to wait and wait and wait to be helped.

reviews.title: Tired of Verizon not appreciating me!
reviews.content: I have been with Verizon for over a year now and have had nothing but experience after experience where they have just outright proven to me that the value they place on me as a customer is a big fat ZERO! I have an account with another National carrier (T-Mobile) that has gone above and beyond to insure that my needs are me, I have the service I want, the equipment I want, and that I am satisfied. As I said I’ve been with Verizon over a year and am eligible for an upgrade so I call for the upgrade and they tell me that they want this astronomical amount of money down in order to upgrade me even though I am trading in an iPhone that over half the the thousand dollar cost is paid off so they get that phone back and want a bunch of upfront money even though I have NEVER required a down payment for anything prior to this! It looks to me like they are intentionally making it a ridiculous price on purpose to keep me from getting any value for the phone I have already been paying for. On my line with T-Mobile the upgrade me from an even older less valuable phone to the new iPhone 13 Pro Max for $0!! What does that say? They actually value me as a customer.As a result I am going to switch completely over to T-Mobile where they actually value me as an individual customer and they appreciate me spending my hard earned money with them! We have choices where we spend our money and I would recommend that you look anywhere other than Verizon, especially if you want treated like you money and business matters!

reviews.title: Worst inefficiency
reviews.content: If this had not been a real company, I would have been sure it was a scam. In an effort to cancel my deceased mother’s landline account, I was given the worst runaround. (This is actually my second post about Verizon.) Initially, I was forced to take a death certificate to one of their regional headquarters, a certificate that the guy didn’t even look at, to cancel. Fine. But then it turns out, we overpaid. Two months later and still no refund. Called them, got a call back half an hour later, then waited for 2 hours to finally get some sort of manager/supervisor who, though very nice, chatted with me for half an hour about everything EXCEPT the refund! Finally, THREE HOURS after my initial call, he told me the check would be sent out automatically. Still waiting. Not only that but the service was really poor. When my mother had internet service, it was cutting out all the time. Very unreliable so she canceled after a year.By the way, during this wait, I was "accidentally" (fake) disconnected for probably 15 minutes, though I held on until the guy got back to me. When I got through to a supervisor, he couldn't hear me! I stayed online until he could suddenly "miraculously" hear me!!!I even went to a corporate office about the refund and they said they didn't even have a phone number or email address!!!Very inefficient!!! Another thing is that they really need an estate section for people who have to cancel deceased relatives accounts.

reviews.title: I wish I could leave zero stars
reviews.content: I wish I could leave zero stars.  They told me my bill would be 123 and it's been 142 and everytime I get on the customer service with verizon, they just throw platitudes my way and say they will fix it going forward and they never do.  I keep overpaying, and wasting an hour each month talking to them while they try to supposedly do something to remedy the situation.  Verizon has gotten worse, do yourself a favor, stay away from this company.  Looks like ATT and Tmobile have surpassed them, never thought that could happen, but this is the world we live in,  where some people look to improve to really help people and get better like ATT and Tmobile and others get complacent and stop caring like verzon.  Buyer beware, don't say I didn't warn you.  Also, they promised me a $500 visa gift card where they told me it would get send to me in 8 weeks and I don't have to do anything but wait, well now they tell me I was supposed to submit a redemption within 30 days.

reviews.title: Company engages in illegal activity.
reviews.content: Phone calls are not made in a secure fashion. They allow random SIP addresses to be added to your line. I can send unencrypted traffic to my phone through my SIP address.Their customer service reps are clueless even at tier 2. I've been able to DOS them from my computer pretty easily which doesn't say much about their tech department that they can't stop someone from taking out their gateways.None of your voice calls are over tcp or tls. They listen in on every call and every text. They have allow their OSINT companies to take the reigns of their network and exploit/hack customers.When I showed them this glaring hole in their security, they refused to send me to their legal department or give me information on how to serve them.They are performing illegal operations and when told the answer was "doesn't every company?"This is not the correct answer. This company is shameful and I'm glad I get to see such a litany of people affirm what I think: this company is terrible, their service is subpar and their fees are outrageous.To top that off, I had no voicemail for months and none of their reps could turn it on.Last, they have a bunch of malicious domains phishing their customers.

reviews.title: They are the #1 leading most miserable company in America
reviews.content: Verizon is so bad I was questioning that the good reviews were fake. I have already written a review for Verizon but I'm writing another because I cannot stress enough how much this company is the biggest scam. Their network speeds aren't even as decent as they used to be, my current is much faster. Kind of disappointed that I've been missing out for awhile. Customer service has always been bad in my experience, but this recent time having Verizon it was absolute GARBAGE. I couldn't tell you how many representatives I've tried to speak with and every single one was awful. And I'm truly not a highly demanding customer. I don't expect refunds, or discounts, I just want my issues to be explained and hopefully resolved. It seems as if they purposely hire people with the worst attitudes. I can't even get somebody to email me my last bill. It's unfortunate enough when you deal with just a couple bad apples, but it's angering when every single associate acts like doing their job is your fault.
